weeks.lecture: Course introduction: What is an AI agent? History of agents and cognitive augmentation; agents as perception-action loops, tool use, and autonomy.
weeks.tutorial: Build a minimal observe-decide-act agent loop and start the documentation website.
weeks.readings: ReAct; surveys on LLM agents; software agents background.

weeks.lecture: Tool use and agent interfaces: function calling, APIs, MCP, schemas, affordances, permissions, and failures.
weeks.tutorial: Build a typed tool-calling agent with five tools and tool-call validation.
weeks.readings: Toolformer; MCP specification; recent tool-use agent papers.

weeks.lecture: Human-agent interaction and cognitive augmentation: delegation, agency, overreliance, deskilling, representation, and human outcomes.
weeks.tutorial: Explore agent interaction design decisions such as hand-off and approval.
weeks.readings: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction; cognitive offloading; Socratic AI; human-AI teaming.

weeks.lecture: Agent environments and evaluation: tasks, environments, state-based grading, metrics, failure taxonomies, cost, and latency.
weeks.tutorial: Build a mini benchmark with 30 tasks and automatic grading.
weeks.readings: Tau-bench; GAIA; AgentBench; benchmark design papers.

weeks.lecture: Browser and computer-use agents: DOM, screenshots, accessibility trees, visual grounding, software control, coding, terminals, and sandboxing.
weeks.tutorial: Build a browser agent for a local website or a coding/terminal agent that fixes small repository issues.
weeks.readings: WebArena; VisualWebArena; Mind2Web; VideoWebArena; SWE-agent; SWE-bench; OSWorld.

weeks.lecture: Memory architectures, context, and personalization: short-term, episodic, semantic, and long-term memory; writing, reading, and forgetting policies.
weeks.tutorial: Build a multi-session agent and compare no memory, naive memory, and selective memory.
weeks.readings: Recent agent memory surveys; Generative Agents.

weeks.lecture: Multimodal agents: vision, audio, video, interaction traces, gaze, screen state, sensor data, and grounding.
weeks.tutorial: Build an agent that uses at least one non-text input.
weeks.readings: GPT-4V, Gemini, and LLaVA-style agent papers; VideoWebArena; OpenVLA.

weeks.lecture: Agentic reinforcement learning and self-improving agents: GRPO, PPO, DPO, trajectories, rewards, feedback, and adaptation.
weeks.tutorial: Fine-tune or adapt a small agent policy using trajectories, preferences, or reward signals.

weeks.lecture: Multi-agent systems and simulated societies: role decomposition, delegation, debate, user simulators, collaboration, and coordination failures.
weeks.tutorial: Build a single-agent versus multi-agent comparison.

weeks.lecture: Wearables, BCIs, and physiology-aware agents: gaze, EEG, EDA, audio, context sensing, and closed-loop systems.
weeks.tutorial: Build a physiology- or context-aware prototype, or use a simulated sensor stream.
weeks.readings: Wearable AI; BCI; affective computing; gaze-aware assistants.

weeks.lecture: Safety, security, and agent behaviors: prompt and tool injection, exfiltration, irreversible actions, sandboxing, audit logs, and approvals.
weeks.readings: MCP security discussions; prompt-injection papers; agent-safety papers.

weeks.lecture: Final project presentations with live demo, paper-style presentation, and failure analysis.
